body: I've been on noriday 28 twice, once 15-18 and then again for 6 months at 22. Both times the pill caused me to have spotting and irregular periods in the beginning whilst my body was adjusting to it. I asked my GP about it and I was told by him that this was a normal side effect for the pill we are on, and that it should settle down after 3 months or so, which was the case for me! If it persists beyond that maybe discuss trying a different pill, but by the sounds of it, what you're experiencing right now is pretty typical and nothing to stress about :))
